title: D-SP-4 Stage 4c batch 1: move agent, ambient, auto, blackboard, brain and broker clap enums into susi-cli-defs

criteria: completes part of T-DSP4WIRE1104-9 (D-SP-4 Stage 4c): AgentCommands, AmbientCommands, AutoCommands, BlackboardCommands, BrainCommands (with its Default impl) and BrokerCommands live in crates/susi-cli-defs/src/<family>.rs and are re-exported from src/cli/<family>_cli.rs, so every caller compiles unchanged
susi-cli-defs keeps #![deny(missing_docs)] and still depends only on susi-vendor-clap
cli_help_and_version_match_snapshot stays byte-identical: no visible help or version text changes

socket_parity reads moved families from crates/susi-cli-defs/src and asserts a non-zero count of moved sources; core_cli_has_no_ui_subcommands also scans crates/susi-cli-defs/src and asserts it found sources

ship-gate root cause fixed in a separate commit: susi-gmcp tests that replace the process-global PlaneBus TOOLS_LIST/TOOLS_EXISTS/TOOLS_EXECUTE handlers (mission_run cancellation wire test, commercial extension-pack wire test) hold one shared TOOLS_PLANE_TEST_LOCK, so neither serves the other's stub; the pair failed 40/40 run together before and passes 40/40 after
